units.source_text: 产品制成后进入销售阶段，胜田感到有点棘手。

en.t: Once the goods were finished and entered the selling stage, Katsuta found things somewhat troublesome.

units.source_text: 产品是无懈可击的。

en.t: The goods themselves were beyond reproach.

units.source_text: 不过在现今这种不景气的时世，不是畅销锦纱男腰带的时候。

en.t: But in these hard times, it was no season for silk men's sashes to sell well.

units.source_text: 即使批发，也没有商人拿现金去进货。

en.t: Even at wholesale, no merchants would come with cash to buy stock.

units.source_text: 如果委托经销，当然到处都会有人接受，总之当今的世态就是这样，所以三天能不能卖出一件，或一周能不能卖上一件都难说。

en.t: If he left them on consignment, of course there would be people everywhere willing to take them, but such were the times that it was hard to say whether even one would sell in three days, or even in a week.

units.source_text: 这还算好的啦，本来胜田的钱也不多余，这些产品不是用闲着没用的钱买来的。

en.t: Even that would have been the better case, for Katsuta had no spare money to begin with, and these goods had not been bought with idle cash.

units.source_text: 只是想赚一笔钱，博博命运，才投机买了进来。

en.t: He had bought them speculatively only because he wanted to make some money and try his luck.

units.source_text: 他是借高利贷的钱买的。

en.t: He had bought them with money borrowed at high interest.

units.source_text: 在这种情况下，搞委托经销这样不慌不忙的买卖，连利息钱都不够付呢。

en.t: Under those circumstances, doing a leisurely business like consignment sales would not even cover the interest.

units.source_text: 于是，他才找到我们店。

en.t: That was why he finally came to our shop.

units.source_text: 这里全都写着呢。

en.t: It is all written here.

units.source_text: 他来到马道町二条松田处理品部，诚恳地进行商谈。

en.t: He came to Matsuda's clearance-goods department at Nijo in Umamichi-cho and negotiated in earnest.

units.source_text: 说是请设法以最快的速度将这些腰带推销出去换成钱。

en.t: He asked us to find some way to sell off these sashes as quickly as possible and turn them into cash.

units.source_text: 我觉得这是一桩买卖，没什么可说的。

en.t: I thought it was simply a business matter, and there was nothing much to say.

units.source_text: 不过，对方倒是挺可怜的。

en.t: Still, the man was rather pitiable.

units.source_text: 我说产品一旦成为处理品，就只能卖出不到行情三分之一的价钱。

en.t: I told him that once goods became clearance items, they could only sell for less than a third of the market price.

units.source_text: 胜田也很沮丧啊。

en.t: Katsuta was deeply discouraged too.

units.source_text: 他说待他回去再考虑考虑，这也是难怪的呀。

en.t: He said he would go back and think it over again, which was only natural.

units.source_text: 可是，第二天他又上门来说，即使只卖到三分之一的价钱，为了解救燃眉之急，也顾不了其他了，反正攥着产品就净花费用，所以拜托你一定把它推销出去。

en.t: But the next day he came back and said that even if they sold for only a third of the price, he had no choice if he was to meet his urgent need; keeping hold of the goods would only cost him money, so he begged us to be sure to sell them off.

units.source_text: 我们打前些日子起就出差到这里来推销，产品是上乘的，价钱又格外便宜，再怎么不景气，好东西客人还是喜欢的，托众客人的福，推销的产品已经所剩无几。

en.t: We had been here on a sales trip since the other day, and because the goods were first-rate and the prices exceptionally low, customers still liked good things no matter how bad the economy was; thanks to them, only a few of the sale items remained.

units.source_text: 从明日起要在这里推销木屐。

en.t: Starting tomorrow, we were to sell wooden clogs here.

units.source_text: 所以哪怕是白送，今天一天也要把这些产品推销完了。

en.t: So even if it meant practically giving them away, we had to finish selling these goods today.
